meta.phase-name: Schema-First Content Source and Kaplay Codegen Wiring

phase-plan.purpose: Create one repo-authored source document for schema and gameplay content, generate runtime contract JSON files from it, and keep Kaplay using those generated outputs.
phase-plan.scope: Engine contract source files, codegen scripts, bundle generation, and Kaplay runtime/bundle usage. No new editor UI in this slice.

file.description: Single authored source document for schema and gameplay content.
Codegen script that emits runtime contract JSON files from the single source document.
Bundle generation should package generated outputs and include the authored schema/source surfaces needed later for import.
Kaplay runtime should consume the generated bundle output and expose the schema-first content pack path cleanly.

task.description: Create a single authored source document from the current schema/gameplay contract data.
Add codegen that emits runtime contract data files from the source document and make engine build/bundle flows run it.
Wire Kaplay content-pack loading and parity surfaces to the generated schema-first output.
